llm_judge_metrics.description: The LLM judge was evaluated against human annotations on a held-out subset of the golden evaluation dataset.

failures.title: Intent Boundary Ambiguity
failures.example_input: Why am I being charged after cancelling my plan?
failures.hypothesis: Intent taxonomy boundaries overlap between billing recurring deductions and subscription lifecycle state management.
failures.mitigation: Introduce hierarchical classification: coarse category (Financial) followed by fine-grained disclaimers.

failures.title: Retrieval Semantic Drift
failures.retrieved_resolution: Historical case retrieved was 'How to request a refund for an erroneous purchase'
failures.hypothesis: Dense embedding captured high-level financial frustration and lexical payment overlap rather than resolution causality.
failures.mitigation: Enforce BM25 term weighting on operative verbs ('failed', 'declined', 'reversal') to balance dense embeddings.

failures.title: Generic Safe Responses
failures.example_input: The equalizer resets every time I pause a podcast on Android Auto
failures.generated_reply: Please contact customer support for further assistance.
failures.hypothesis: Over-conservative abstention penalties in the generation prompt cause model collapse into generic non-answers.
failures.mitigation: Tune prompt instruction to provide actionable diagnostic steps when retrieval confidence is intermediate.

failures.title: Historical Policy Drift
failures.example_input: Can I download songs to an Apple Watch without my iPhone nearby?
failures.retrieved_resolution: A 2019 tweet stating 'Offline Apple Watch playback is currently unsupported.'
failures.hypothesis: Historical Twitter responses reflect outdated platform capabilities prior to the watchOS offline storage release.
failures.mitigation: Timestamp-decay weighting in FAISS vector store; discard historical evidence older than policy freshness window.

failures.title: False Auto-Handling
failures.example_input: I can't log in because the recovery SMS was sent to an unknown number +79...
failures.hypothesis: Model focused on the phrase 'can't log in' with 91% confidence, overlooking the country code hijack indicator.
failures.mitigation: Hard rule regex and keyword sentinel in EscalationEngine for compromised phone numbers, foreign country codes, and takeover terms.
